diapositivas.codigoAnimacion:
<a-entity id="escena_estudio" position="0 0 0" scale="0.12 0.12 0.12">

    <!-- 1. ILUMINACIÓN COMPLETA DE LABORATORIO (Luz cinemática con sombras suaves) -->
    <a-light type="ambient" color="#ffffff" intensity="1.25"></a-light>
    <a-light type="directional" color="#ffffff" intensity="1.45" position="0 6 4"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#00f0ff" intensity="2.2" distance="15" position="-2.5 2 3"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#fbbf24" intensity="1.9" distance="15" position="2.5 2 3"></a-light>

    <!-- 2. PLATAFORMA DE CALIBRACIÓN Y DISCO REFLECTANTE EN EL SUELO -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.9 0">
        <!-- Haz de luz reflejado en la diapositiva -->
        <a-circle radius="3.6" rotation="-90 0 0" position="0 -0.01 0"
            material="color: #0284c7; opacity: 0.25; transparent: true; roughness: 0.3; metalness: 0.8">
        </a-circle>
        <!-- Diales de medición milimétrica concéntricos -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="3.3" radius-outer="3.5" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #00f0ff; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.85; opacity: 0.8; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 360 0; dur: 32000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>
        <a-ring radius-inner="2.4" radius-outer="2.55" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.75; opacity: 0.75; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 -360 0; dur: 22000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>
        <a-ring radius-inner="1.5" radius-outer="1.62" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #34d399; emissive: #059669; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true; side: double">
        </a-ring>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 3. PERSONAJE CIENTÍFICO / PROFESOR DE METODOLOGÍA DICIENDO BIENVENIDOS (Derecha) -->
    <a-entity position="2.8 -0.7 0.7" rotation="0 -22 0"
        animation="property: position; to: 2.8 -0.66 0.7; dir: alternate; dur: 2200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        
        <!-- Cabeza y Rostro Amable -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.22" position="0 1.22 0" material="color: #fed7aa; roughness: 0.6"></a-sphere>
        <!-- Cabello Castaño Peinado -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.23" position="0 1.28 -0.04" material="color: #332414; roughness: 0.8"></a-sphere>
        <!-- Gafas de Profesor / Investigador -->
        <a-torus radius="0.055" radius-tubular="0.009" position="-0.07 1.24 0.2" material="color: #0f172a; metalness: 0.8"></a-torus>
        <a-torus radius="0.055" radius-tubular="0.009" position="0.07 1.24 0.2" material="color: #0f172a; metalness: 0.8"></a-torus>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.007" height="0.05" position="0 1.24 0.2" rotation="0 0 90" material="color: #0f172a"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Ojos y Sonrisa Cordial -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.02" position="-0.07 1.24 0.21" material="color: #0f172a"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.02" position="0.07 1.24 0.21" material="color: #0f172a"></a-sphere>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.035" height="0.01" position="0 1.15 0.21" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #ef4444"></a-cylinder>

        <!-- Torso con Bata Blanca de Laboratorio -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.26" height="0.75" position="0 0.68 0" material="color: #f8fafc; roughness: 0.4"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Camisa y Corbata Azul Académica -->
        <a-plane width="0.12" height="0.38" position="0 0.75 0.25" material="color: #0284c7"></a-plane>
        <a-box width="0.05" height="0.28" depth="0.02" position="0 0.7 0.26" material="color: #1e3a8a"></a-box>
        <!-- Bolígrafo Dorado en el Bolsillo Superior -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.012" height="0.14" position="0.12 0.86 0.25" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Gafete / Credencial de Investigador -->
        <a-box width="0.09" height="0.12" depth="0.02" position="0.14 0.76 0.25" material="color: #38bdf8"></a-box>

        <!-- Brazo Izquierdo: Sosteniendo Portapapeles con Anotaciones Científicas -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.45" position="-0.26 0.65 0.08" rotation="20 0 15" material="color: #f8fafc"></a-cylinder>
        <a-box width="0.24" height="0.34" depth="0.02" position="-0.3 0.52 0.2" rotation="-15 20 0" material="color: #78350f">
            <!-- Hoja de Datos con Check de Validación Verde -->
            <a-plane width="0.2" height="0.28" position="0 0 0.015" material="color: #f8fafc">
                <a-circle radius="0.025" position="0.05 0.08 0.005" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #16a34a; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-circle>
            </a-plane>
        </a-box>

        <!-- Brazo Derecho: ¡SALUDANDO EN MOVIMIENTO CONTINUO A LOS ALUMNOS! -->
        <a-entity position="0.28 0.88 0"
            animation="property: rotation; to: 0 0 -35; dir: alternate; dur: 700; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
            <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.48" position="0.16 0.16 0.05" rotation="0 0 -45" material="color: #f8fafc"></a-cylinder>
            <a-sphere radius="0.075" position="0.34 0.34 0.05" material="color: #fed7aa"></a-sphere>
        </a-entity>

        <!-- Piernas y Calzado Formal -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.085" height="0.65" position="-0.11 0.05 0" material="color: #1e293b"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.085" height="0.65" position="0.11 0.05 0" material="color: #1e293b"></a-cylinder>
        <a-box width="0.13" height="0.08" depth="0.22" position="-0.11 -0.28 0.05" material="color: #0f172a"></a-box>
        <a-box width="0.13" height="0.08" depth="0.22" position="0.11 -0.28 0.05" material="color: #0f172a"></a-box>

        <!-- BOCADILLO DE DIÁLOGO FLOTANTE "¡BIENVENIDOS!" -->
        <a-entity position="-0.2 1.8 0.1"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.08 1.08 1.08; dir: alternate; dur: 1200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
            <a-plane width="1.7" height="0.6" material="color: #ffffff; roughness: 0.2; side: double"></a-plane>
            <a-plane width="1.76" height="0.66" position="0 0 -0.01" material="color: #00f0ff; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-plane>
            <a-triangle vertex-a="0 0 0" vertex-b="0.18 -0.22 0" vertex-c="-0.08 -0.05 0" position="0.2 -0.26 0.01" material="color: #ffffff; side: double"></a-triangle>
            <a-text value="¡Bienvenidos!" align="center" color="#0f172a" width="3.4" position="0 0.02 0.02"></a-text>
        </a-entity>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 4. MICROSCOPIO CIENTÍFICO CON ESCÁNER LÁSER ACTIVO (Derecha Fondo) -->
    <a-entity position="3.5 -0.8 -0.2" rotation="0 -40 0">
        <a-cylinder radius="0.65" height="0.1" position="0 0 0" material="color: #1e293b; metalness: 0.8; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-box width="0.18" height="1.4" depth="0.2" position="-0.35 0.75 0" rotation="0 0 -15" material="color: #334155; metalness: 0.8"></a-box>
        <a-box width="0.85" height="0.04" depth="0.75" position="0.05 0.7 0" material="color: #020617; metalness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <a-box width="0.55" height="0.015" depth="0.22" position="0.05 0.73 0" material="color: #a5f3fc; opacity: 0.55; transparent: true"></a-box>
        <a-circle radius="0.06" position="0.05 0.745 0" rotation="-90 0 0" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #16a34a; emissiveIntensity: 1"></a-circle>
        
        <!-- Láser de Escaneo -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="0.08" radius-outer="0.24" position="0.05 0.76 0" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #4ade80; emissive: #22c55e; emissiveIntensity: 1; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: position; to: 0.05 1.05 0; dir: alternate; dur: 1400; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-ring>

        <a-cylinder radius="0.28" height="0.08" position="0.05 1.35 0" material="color: #475569; metalness: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.3" position="0.05 1.18 0.12" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.35" position="0.05 1.18 -0.12" material="color: #00f0ff; metalness: 0.9"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.12" height="0.75" position="0.05 1.75 0" rotation="0 0 -25" material="color: #0f172a; metalness: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 5. MATRAZ ERLENMEYER CON MECHERO BUNSEN, LLAMA Y VAPOR (Izquierda Abajo) -->
    <a-entity position="-3.3 -0.8 0.2" rotation="0 25 0">
        <!-- Mechero Bunsen -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.38" height="0.08" position="0 -0.05 0" material="color: #334155; metalness: 0.9"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.08" height="0.35" position="0 0.12 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Llama azul viva animada -->
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.09" radius-top="0.01" height="0.28" position="0 0.38 0"
            material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 1.5; opacity: 0.9; transparent: true"
            animation="property: scale; to: 0.85 1.3 0.85; dir: alternate; dur: 200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-cone>
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.04" radius-top="0.005" height="0.16" position="0 0.35 0"
            material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #ffffff; emissiveIntensity: 2; opacity: 0.95; transparent: true">
        </a-cone>

        <!-- Matraz de Vidrio Pírex -->
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.8" radius-top="0.25" height="1.1" position="0 0.95 0"
            material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.35; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9; side: double">
        </a-cone>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.24" height="0.65" position="0 1.75 0"
            material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.35; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9; side: double">
        </a-cylinder>
        <!-- Líquido Reactivo Hirviente -->
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.75" radius-top="0.45" height="0.6" position="0 0.72 0"
            material="color: #06b6d4; emissive: #0891b2; emissiveIntensity: 0.75; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true">
        </a-cone>
        <!-- 3 Burbujas Químicas Ascendentes -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.05" position="-0.15 0.5 0.1" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: position; to: -0.15 1.05 0.1; dur: 1100; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.065" position="0.2 0.45 -0.1" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: position; to: 0.2 1.05 -0.1; dur: 1500; loop: true; delay: 300; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>

        <!-- VAPOR QUÍMICO SUTIL SALIENDO DE LA BOCA DEL MATRAZ -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.08" position="0 2.1 0" material="color: #bae6fd; opacity: 0.4; transparent: true"
            animation="property: position; to: 0.05 2.5 0; dur: 2000; loop: true; easing: linear"
            animation__scale="property: scale; to: 1.8 1.8 1.8; dur: 2000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>

        <!-- Gradilla con Tubos de Ensayo -->
        <a-entity position="0.95 0.3 0.2">
            <a-box width="0.8" height="0.05" depth="0.3" position="0 0 0" material="color: #78350f"></a-box>
            <a-box width="0.8" height="0.05" depth="0.3" position="0 0.5 0" material="color: #78350f"></a-box>
            <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.35" position="-0.25 0.2 0" material="color: #ef4444; emissive: #b91c1c; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
            <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.4" position="0 0.22 0" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #15803d; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
            <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.3" position="0.25 0.18 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #ca8a04; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
        </a-entity>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 6. CADENA DE ADN MOLECULAR ROTATORIA (Izquierda Arriba) -->
    <a-entity position="-2.9 1.8 0.3"
        animation="property: rotation; to: 0 360 0; dur: 8500; loop: true; easing: linear"
        animation__pos="property: position; to: -2.9 2.05 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 2600; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 0.6 0" rotation="0 0 90" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="-0.45 0.6 0" material="color: #ef4444; emissive: #b91c1c; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0.45 0.6 0" material="color: #3b82f6; emissive: #1d4ed8; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 0.2 0" rotation="0 45 90" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="-0.32 0.2 0.32" material="color: #eab308; emissive: #ca8a04; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0.32 0.2 -0.32" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #15803d; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 -0.2 0" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0 -0.2 0.45" material="color: #06b6d4; emissive: #0891b2; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0 -0.2 -0.45" material="color: #a855f7; emissive: #7e22ce; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 7. BOMBILLA EUREKA RODEADA DE ÓRBITAS ATÓMICAS (Centro Cúspide) -->
    <a-entity position="0 2.8 0.1"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 3.02 0.1; dir: alternate; dur: 2400; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Globo de cristal incandescente -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.45" material="color: #fef08a; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 0.95"></a-sphere>
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.42" radius-top="0.22" height="0.3" position="0 -0.32 0" material="color: #fef08a; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 0.95"></a-cone>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.2" height="0.25" position="0 -0.58 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-torus radius="0.16" radius-tubular="0.02" position="0 0 0" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #ffffff; emissiveIntensity: 2"></a-torus>
        
        <!-- ÓRBITA ATÓMICA ALREDEDOR DE LA BOMBILLA -->
        <a-entity rotation="60 30 0" animation="property: rotation; to: 60 390 0; dur: 6000; loop: true; easing: linear">
            <a-torus radius="0.8" radius-tubular="0.015" material="color: #00f0ff; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true"></a-torus>
            <a-sphere radius="0.07" position="0.8 0 0" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #00f0ff; emissiveIntensity: 1.2"></a-sphere>
        </a-entity>
        <a-entity rotation="-60 -30 0" animation="property: rotation; to: -60 -390 0; dur: 7500; loop: true; easing: linear">
            <a-torus radius="0.9" radius-tubular="0.015" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true"></a-torus>
            <a-sphere radius="0.07" position="-0.9 0 0" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 1.2"></a-sphere>
        </a-entity>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 8. GRAN LIBRO ABIERTO DE METODOLOGÍA CON COMPÁS (Centro Abajo) -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.35 0.5" rotation="28 0 0"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 -1.22 0.5; dir: alternate; dur: 3200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-cylinder radius="0.08" height="1.6" position="0 0 -0.05" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #d97706; metalness: 0.85; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-box width="1.15" height="0.06" depth="1.55" position="-0.56 0.05 0" rotation="0 0 14" material="color: #fffbeb; roughness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <a-box width="1.2" height="0.04" depth="1.6" position="-0.58 0.01 0" rotation="0 0 14" material="color: #1e1b4b; roughness: 0.4"></a-box>
        <!-- Gráficos científicos en página izquierda -->
        <a-plane width="0.8" height="1.15" position="-0.54 0.09 0" rotation="-90 14 0" material="color: #0284c7; opacity: 0.5; transparent: true"></a-plane>
        <a-box width="1.15" height="0.06" depth="1.55" position="0.56 0.05 0" rotation="0 0 -14" material="color: #fffbeb; roughness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <a-box width="1.2" height="0.04" depth="1.6" position="0.58 0.01 0" rotation="0 0 -14" material="color: #1e1b4b; roughness: 0.4"></a-box>
        <!-- Anotaciones en página derecha -->
        <a-plane width="0.8" height="1.15" position="0.54 0.09 0" rotation="-90 -14 0" material="color: #d97706; opacity: 0.5; transparent: true"></a-plane>
        <a-box width="0.1" height="0.02" depth="1.75" position="0 0.08 0.1" material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-box>
        <!-- Compás de Medición -->
        <a-entity position="0 0.14 0.2" rotation="-90 0 0">
            <a-cylinder radius="0.02" height="0.6" position="-0.12 0 0" rotation="0 0 20" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
            <a-cylinder radius="0.02" height="0.6" position="0.12 0 0" rotation="0 0 -20" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
            <a-sphere radius="0.04" position="0 0.3 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9"></a-sphere>
        </a-entity>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 9. HUD HOLOGRÁFICO LATERAL DE DATOS (Izquierda) -->
    <a-plane width="1.6" height="0.9" position="-2.7 0.3 0.6" rotation="0 20 0"
        material="color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.8; transparent: true; roughness: 0.5">
        <a-text value="[ VARIABLES ]\n• X: Causa (Indep)\n• Y: Efecto (Dep)\n• Control: 100%" color="#38bdf8" width="2.2" position="0 0 0.02" align="center"></a-text>
    </a-plane>

    <!-- 10. DIAGRAMA DE FLUJO DE LAS 4 ETAPAS DEL MÉTODO CIENTÍFICO (Frontal Bajo) -->
    <a-entity position="0 -0.45 0.92">
        <!-- Paso 1: Observar -->
        <a-plane width="0.95" height="0.25" position="-1.65 0 0" material="color: #0369a1; opacity: 0.9">
            <a-text value="1. Observar" align="center" color="#ffffff" width="2.2" position="0 0 0.01"></a-text>
        </a-plane>
        <a-text value="►" position="-1.1 0 0.01" color="#38bdf8" width="2.2" align="center"></a-text>

        <!-- Paso 2: Hipótesis -->
        <a-plane width="0.95" height="0.25" position="-0.55 0 0" material="color: #b45309; opacity: 0.9">
            <a-text value="2. Hipotesis" align="center" color="#ffffff" width="2.2" position="0 0 0.01"></a-text>
        </a-plane>
        <a-text value="►" position="0 0 0.01" color="#fbbf24" width="2.2" align="center"></a-text>

        <!-- Paso 3: Experimento -->
        <a-plane width="0.95" height="0.25" position="0.55 0 0" material="color: #701a75; opacity: 0.9">
            <a-text value="3. Experimento" align="center" color="#ffffff" width="2.2" position="0 0 0.01"></a-text>
        </a-plane>
        <a-text value="►" position="1.1 0 0.01" color="#e879f9" width="2.2" align="center"></a-text>

        <!-- Paso 4: Conclusión -->
        <a-plane width="0.95" height="0.25" position="1.65 0 0" material="color: #15803d; opacity: 0.9">
            <a-text value="4. Conclusion" align="center" color="#ffffff" width="2.2" position="0 0 0.01"></a-text>
        </a-plane>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 11. EL TEXTO FLOTANTE ULTRA-LEGIBLE CON CAMBIO DE COLOR EN 60 FPS (Al frente: Z = 0.9) -->
    <a-entity position="0 0.45 0.9"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 0.58 0.9; dir: alternate; dur: 2500; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">

        <!-- Panel de contraste protector oscuro -->
        <a-plane width="4.9" height="2.0" position="0 0.1 -0.06"
            material="color: #030712; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; roughness: 0.5">
        </a-plane>

        <!-- Insignia Superior -->
        <a-plane width="3.4" height="0.36" position="0 0.95 0.01"
            material="color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.95; transparent: true">
            <a-text value="🎓 METODO CIENTIFICO • UNIDAD I" align="center" color="#38bdf8" width="3.6" position="0 0 0.02"></a-text>
        </a-plane>

        <!-- CAPA GLOW TRASERA (Cambia de color automáticamente con app.js) -->
        <a-text 
            class="texto-glow-cambiante"
            value="Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de Metodologia\nde Investigacion" 
            color="#00f0ff" 
            align="center" 
            width="4.9"
            line-height="62"
            position="0.02 0.22 -0.01">
        </a-text>

        <!-- CAPA PRINCIPAL FRONTAL (Cambia de color en bucle continuo a 60 FPS) -->
        <a-text 
            class="texto-color-cambiante"
